inferential_unit.primary_cycle: single preregistered final relational-state cycle per base fixture
inferential_unit.temporal_negative_control: pre-relation or first-evidence cycle is paired to its base fixture and never increases n
inferential_unit.cluster_rule: all variants, cycles, channels, and paired controls derived from one base fixture remain in the same split/fold/bootstrap cluster

minimum_independent_groups.shortfall_rule: NotEstablished; do not relax thresholds or count metamorphic/cycle replicas as replacement groups

splitting.leakage_rule: an identity or lineage capable of leaking target semantics must not cross training/held-out boundaries

preprocessing.primary_linear_probe: training-fold z-score using training mean/std only; drop training-zero-variance coordinates
preprocessing.binary_hdc_surface_control: same linear family and nested-CV protocol; no target-aware dimensionality reduction
preprocessing.chunk32_surface_control: same linear family and nested-CV protocol
preprocessing.typed_telemetry: structured sensitivity/control only; excluded from latent-abstraction superiority claim
preprocessing.class_rebalancing: training class weights allowed; no synthetic oversampling; held-out distribution is never resampled to balance classes

linear_probe.finalization: refit once on full development-training partition at selected regularization; freeze coefficients, intercept, preprocessing statistics, feature order, and channel before held-out evaluation

resampling.bootstrap_pairing: paired across recurrent and perceptual-control channels using identical resampled base fixture IDs
resampling.chance_test: one-sided grouped label-permutation test against balanced-accuracy 0.50
resampling.surface_superiority_test: one-sided paired cluster-bootstrap test of recurrent balanced-accuracy minus the better perceptual-control balanced-accuracy > 0
resampling.surface_control_selection: better control is selected on development-training/nested-CV performance only, never held-out labels

multiplicity.rule: a frontier atom must satisfy its raw interval gates and both applicable Holm-adjusted p-value gates

secondary: AUROC when both classes are present

paired_surface_comparison.claim_rule: frontier abstraction beyond perception is NotEstablished unless recurrent state passes both above-chance and paired superiority gates

stopping.allowed_extension: only a prospectively timestamped amendment made before any held-out development labels are opened
